latest_final: The opening is wordplay. The student is not talking about academic course registration, even though he is a university student with a "deadline." The "courses" are the courses of a meal—the successive dishes of a formal dinner that he had to choose in advance. He attended that dinner, and during the single evening each chosen course was brought out, served, and then cleared away as the meal progressed. So "all of my courses were gone in one evening" means that every dish in the multi-course dinner was served and taken away within that same evening; the meal was consumed course by course, and by the end nothing remained. Nothing was actually lost from a course-selection system—the phrase simply describes the courses of the dinner coming and going during one evening.
